note: Both sets capture the two key figure values (∂P/∂θ at θ=0° = -25.52E+6 watt/rad and 6.302336°) with supporting quotes, and both duplicate the pitch-sensitivity claim. However, both mislabel 6.302336° as plain θ when the text defines it as θK (the blade-pitch angle where pitch sensitivity has doubled), and Set A additionally misbinds it to the 'best-fit line intercept', which the text says is a different term. Set B's version of that claim is vague rather than contradicted, but both sets carry the same number of mislabeled/duplicate claims and both omit the θK definition, so they are effectively equivalent.
